overview: An international terrorist has New York in a grip of panic and it's up to Det. Sgt. Deke DaSilva to take him down.
tagline: A terrorist holds New York in a grip of fear - and only Stallone can take him on.

recs.blurb: The secret US abduction of a suspected terrorist leads to a wave of terrorist attacks in New York that lead to the declaration of martial law.
